memories.title: Axis Logistics
memories.excerpt: Freight forwarder that ships finished arms to customers in the US and EU.

memories.title: Brightline
memories.excerpt: Audit firm engaged for Acme's SOC 2 Type II. Performed the 2025 audit and is booked for the renewal window opening Nov 1.

memories.title: Ferro Castings
memories.excerpt: Aluminum castings supplier for the arm's shoulder and elbow housings.

memories.title: Gripworks
memories.excerpt: Supplier of soft robotic grippers. Proposed a 12-month supply agreement at $40k for the Gripper v2 fingertip pads and actuators.

memories.title: Halden Compliance
memories.excerpt: Former compliance contractor. Ran Acme's 2025 SOC 2 audit prep as fractional compliance lead; the engagement ended in January 2026.

memories.title: Harbor Cloud
memories.excerpt: Cloud provider hosting the fleet telemetry platform and customer dashboards.

memories.title: Lumen Ventures
memories.excerpt: Venture firm that led Acme's $12M Series A in 2024. Holds one board observer seat, filled by Ada Chen.

memories.title: Northgate Bank
memories.excerpt: Acme's operating bank and venture debt lender ($4M facility).

memories.title: Voltcell
memories.excerpt: Battery pack supplier for the arm's mobile base. 24-month supply agreement signed in 2025.

memories.title: Access Review, Q2 2026
memories.excerpt: Quarterly access review for Q2 2026: 212 accounts reviewed, 9 revoked. Completed Jul 3, two days late. Q3 review not yet scheduled.

memories.title: Arm Controller
memories.excerpt: Real-time controller board for the arm: 1 kHz joint loop, safety-rated stop, telemetry uplink to the cloud platform.

memories.title: Cloud Infrastructure
memories.excerpt: Fleet telemetry and customer dashboards run on Harbor Cloud: two regions (US-East, EU-Central), Postgres plus object storage, $29k per month.

memories.title: Firmware 4.2
memories.excerpt: Arm controller firmware 4.2: adds Gripper v2 support and force-limited grasping. Release candidate cut Sep 24; ship target Oct 8.

memories.title: Gripper v2
memories.excerpt: Second-generation soft gripper for the Acme arm. Pads and actuators sourced from Gripworks; pilot builds start in November once the MSA is signed.

memories.title: Hardware BOM
memories.excerpt: Bill of materials for the Acme arm: $14.2k unit cost. Top lines: castings $3.1k, battery pack $2.4k, controller board $1.9k, gripper $1.2k.

memories.title: Incident Response Plan
memories.excerpt: Severity levels, paging and customer notice rules. Sev-1 incidents page on-call and notify affected customers within 24 hours.

memories.title: Manufacturing Yield
memories.excerpt: First-pass yield 86% in August, down from 91% in June. Casting porosity accounts for most scrap.

memories.title: On-call Rotation
memories.excerpt: Weekly on-call rotation across six firmware and cloud engineers. This week's primary: Nikhil Brandt.

memories.title: Eng Roadmap, H2 2026
memories.excerpt: H2 priorities: ship Gripper v2 pilot, Firmware 4.2, cut BOM cost 8%, pass SOC 2 renewal. Compliance ownership listed as "TBD".

memories.title: Security Policy
memories.excerpt: Information security policy, last reviewed March. Lists controls but names no compliance owner.

memories.title: SOC 2 2025 Report
memories.excerpt: SOC 2 Type II report for the 2025 period, issued by Brightline in December 2025. Unqualified opinion, two exceptions (late access review, one missing vendor review).

memories.title: SOC 2 Evidence Tracker
memories.excerpt: Evidence checklist for the 2026 SOC 2 audit. 34 controls, 3 with evidence filed, 31 not started. Owner column is blank for every control.

memories.title: SOC 2 Owner
memories.excerpt: Role page for the SOC 2 program owner. Owner: not recorded.

memories.title: SOC 2 Renewal
memories.excerpt: SOC 2 Type II renewal window opens Nov 1. Auditor: Brightline. Evidence collection not started. Owner: see SOC 2 Owner page.

memories.title: Vendor Risk Reviews
memories.excerpt: Security questionnaires for suppliers with data or network access. 2026: Gripworks passed (Aug), Harbor Cloud passed (Jul), Brightline passed (Jun).

memories.title: 2025 Financial Audit
memories.excerpt: FY2025 financial statement audit completed April 2026 with a clean opinion. One recommendation: formalize PO approvals.

memories.title: Q2 Board Meeting Notes
memories.excerpt: Q2 board meeting, May 14. Approved the 2026 operating plan revision and the venture debt drawdown. No commitments to observers.

memories.title: Q3 Board Meeting Notes
memories.excerpt: Committed to Ada Chen: a hardware gross-margin plan by Dec 15 and monthly burn updates. Meeting held Aug 13; attendees Mara Okafor, Raj Patel, two directors and observer Ada Chen.

memories.title: Board Action Items
memories.excerpt: Open board follow-ups. From Q3: gross-margin plan due Dec 15 (Raj Patel, not started); monthly burn updates (Iris Kowalczyk, August sent).

memories.title: Q3 2026 Budget
memories.excerpt: Q3 supplier line $70k, fully committed (Voltcell battery packs and Ferro castings). Closed at 4% over plan.

memories.title: Q4 2026 Budget
memories.excerpt: Supplier line: $55k allocated, $15k committed. Gripworks ($40k) fits within the line. Owner: Raj Patel.

memories.title: Burn Report, August 2026
memories.excerpt: August net burn $610k, cash $7.9M, runway 13 months. First monthly burn update sent to the board per the Q3 commitment.

memories.title: Expense Policy
memories.excerpt: Employee expenses: submit within 30 days, receipts over $50, travel booked through the company tool. Managers approve up to $2k.

memories.title: Gross Margin Plan
memories.excerpt: Draft plan to lift hardware gross margin from 31% to 45% by end of 2027. Due to the board Dec 15, promised at the Q3 board meeting. Owner: Raj Patel.

memories.title: 2026 Operating Plan
memories.excerpt: 2026 plan: $9.5M revenue, 52 people by year end, hardware gross margin 38%. Revised in April; the margin target has since slipped.

memories.title: Purchase Order Policy
memories.excerpt: POs up to $25k are approved by the Controller; POs over $25k need the VP Finance (Raj Patel). A PO is not a contract signature.

memories.title: Runway Forecast
memories.excerpt: Base case runway 13 months at current burn; 17 months with the undrawn $2M of venture debt.

memories.title: Supplier Spend Ledger
memories.excerpt: Committed and paid supplier spend by quarter. Q4 to date: Ferro Castings PO $15k committed. Gripworks not yet committed.

memories.title: Venture Debt Facility
memories.excerpt: $4M facility from Northgate Bank; $2M drawn in May. Covenant: monthly financials and minimum cash $2M.

memories.title: Legal Approvals Log
memories.excerpt: Gripworks MSA v3 approved by Tomas Reyes on Sep 22, pending budget confirmation. Signature requires an authorized signatory for contracts over $30k.

memories.title: Axis Logistics MSA
memories.excerpt: Freight MSA with Axis Logistics. Rate card renews annually; the 2026 rate card was never attached to the signed copy.

memories.title: Board Consents
memories.excerpt: Written consents of the board. The Aug 14 consent reconfirmed signature authority: contracts over $30k need the CEO or COO.

memories.title: Contract Playbook
memories.excerpt: Legal's standard positions for vendor contracts: Net-45 payment, liability cap at 1x fees, 12-month default term, Delaware law.

memories.title: Export Controls
memories.excerpt: The arm and controller ship under EAR99; no license needed for US and EU customers. Shipments to embargoed destinations are blocked.

memories.title: Ferro Castings PO Terms
memories.excerpt: Standard purchase order terms for Ferro Castings. Per-PO pricing, Net-30, scrap over 4% is credited back.

memories.title: Gripworks MSA
memories.excerpt: Master services agreement draft v3. Net-45 payment, 12-month term, liability cap 1x fees. Redlines resolved Sep 20. Contract value $40k.

memories.title: Harbor Cloud DPA
memories.excerpt: Data processing agreement with Harbor Cloud covering fleet telemetry and customer dashboard data. Standard contractual clauses attached for EU customers.

memories.title: IP Assignment
memories.excerpt: Every employee and contractor signs the invention assignment agreement on day one. Contractor agreements without it are void for Eng work.

memories.title: NDA Template
memories.excerpt: Mutual NDA template, two-year term, used for every supplier and customer conversation before pricing is shared.

memories.title: Soft Wrist Patent
memories.excerpt: US provisional patent for the compliant wrist joint used with Gripper v2. Non-provisional filing due March 2027.

memories.title: Privacy Policy
memories.excerpt: Customer privacy policy for fleet telemetry and dashboards. Telemetry is retained 13 months; customers can request deletion.

memories.title: Series A Documents
memories.excerpt: Series A financing documents: $12M led by Lumen Ventures in 2024. Investor rights include one board observer and monthly financials.

memories.title: Acme Trademarks
memories.excerpt: Registered marks: ACME ROBOTICS (US, EU) and GRIPPER V2 (pending US). Renewal docket owned by Legal.

memories.title: Vendor Onboarding
memories.excerpt: Steps to onboard a new supplier: NDA, vendor risk review, contract per playbook, budget confirmation from Finance, then signature.

memories.title: Voltcell Supply Agreement
memories.excerpt: 24-month battery supply agreement with Voltcell, signed March 2025. $180k per year, Net-30, price review each April.

memories.title: Ada Chen
memories.excerpt: Board observer from Lumen Ventures. At the Q3 board meeting she asked for a hardware gross-margin plan by year end, and she follows up on monthly burn numbers.

memories.title: Dev Lindqvist
memories.excerpt: COO. Runs operations, logistics and manufacturing, and signs contracts over $30k when the CEO is unavailable.

memories.title: Employee Handbook
memories.excerpt: Company handbook: working hours, PTO, expenses, equipment and security basics for every employee.

memories.title: Iris Kowalczyk
memories.excerpt: Controller. Runs month-end close, the supplier spend ledger and the monthly burn report.

memories.title: Lena Vogt
memories.excerpt: Head of People. Runs hiring, onboarding and the employee handbook.

memories.title: Mara Okafor
memories.excerpt: CEO and co-founder of Acme Robotics. Chairs the board and signs contracts over $30k.

memories.title: Nikhil Brandt
memories.excerpt: Firmware lead. Owns the arm controller firmware and release trains.

memories.title: Onboarding Guide
memories.excerpt: First-week checklist for new hires: accounts, handbook, security training, team intros.

memories.title: Org Chart
memories.excerpt: Acme Robotics, 48 people. Teams: Finance (Raj Patel), Legal (Tomas Reyes), Eng (Priya Nand), People (Lena Vogt). CEO Mara Okafor, COO Dev Lindqvist.

memories.title: Priya Nand
memories.excerpt: VP Engineering and co-founder. Leads the 34-person Eng team: hardware, firmware and cloud.

memories.title: Raj Patel
memories.excerpt: VP Finance. Owns the Q4 budget and signs purchase orders over $25k.

memories.title: Authorized Signatories
memories.excerpt: Contracts over $30k need the CEO (Mara Okafor) or COO (Dev Lindqvist) to sign. Contracts up to $30k can be signed by the General Counsel (Tomas Reyes) once budget is confirmed.

memories.title: Tomas Reyes
memories.excerpt: General Counsel. Leads Legal, approves every vendor contract and keeps the approvals log.
